Recounted by tools/verify_claims.py on every run.
The runtime VTOR at 0x13200 resolves only because the hand-written shims are pinned at the raw handler addresses (0x1F8/0x290/0x2E0/0x374/0x34D8). Those shims are not the original handlers.
The 0x200-byte trampoline at RAM_DATA 0x20000988 is raw machine code carried as data; it is byte-exact but not reconstructed or relinked.
